title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Chinese)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote AI Quality Analyst (Chinese) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Chinese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Chinese with a high degree of comp, as Chinese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) - Remoto, Full time, Brasil


A Bytenana é uma empresa americana que constrói produtos de software (SaaS) para clientes nos Estados Unidos. Trabalhamos como parceiros de engenharia — colaboração em tempo real, mentalidade de produto e autonomia.


Qual é o perfil


Esta não é uma vaga de Data Engineer puro, nem de Full Stack fraco em dados. Procuramos um(a) Full Stack Engineer com inclinação a dados/backend : alguém que entrega produto de ponta a ponta (API em Node, tela em React, deploy em AWS) e, ao mesmo tempo, é acima da média em modelar PostgreSQL/PostGIS e construir pipelines em Python que alimentam esse produto.


Nossa stack


  • Node, React, AWS, PostgreSQL, Python
  • PostGIS / dados geoespaciais em alguns projetos


Requisitos — núcleo inegociável


  • Workflow agêntico com Claude Code (obrigatório). Não basta usar IA como autocomplete. Buscamos quem delega tarefas multi-passo ao agente (planejar → implementar → rodar testes → corrigir), usa CLAUDE.md/memória de projeto, escreve boas instruções, monta comandos/subagentes, revisa criticamente o que o agente produz, sempre assinando o commit, assumindo responsabilidade.
  • Banco de dados forte (o diferencial real do pleno que anda sozinho): modelagem relacional sólida, SQL complexo sem depender de ORM, índices, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, particionamento, transações e locks.
  • Python para pipelines em produção : ETL/ELT de verdade (não notebook), agendamento, idempotência, validação de dados, tratamento de falhas e reprocessamento.
  • Backend em Node : REST/GraphQL, autenticação, estruturação de serviço respeitando o padrão existente.
  • React : consome API, gerencia estado e entrega tela funcional (não precisa ser especialista em UI).
  • AWS : S3, RDS, Lambda/ECS, IAM básico, sabendo fazer deploy e debugar em cloud com autonomia.
  • ~4 a 6 anos de experiência prática , com autonomia em ambiguidade: recebe um requisito vago, faz as perguntas certas, decide a modelagem e entrega sem acompanhamento passo a passo.
  • Inglês suficiente para conversar e trabalhar com clientes nos EUA no dia a dia.


O que você já deve ter construído


  • Pelo menos um produto/SaaS em produção que tocou de ponta a ponta (banco → API → tela), idealmente com usuários reais e dados crescendo
  • Um pipeline de dados rodando em produção, agendado, monitorado, que já quebrou e você consertou
  • Um schema de banco desenhado do zero, com justificativa para as decisões
  • Histórico de otimização (ex.: \"uma query de 40s que baixei para 200ms\")


Diferenciais (nice-to-have)


  • PostGIS / dados geoespaciais: tipos geométricos, índices GiST, funções ST_*, projeções/SRID, tiles, mapas, geocoding, cálculo de distância/área, rotas
  • Orquestrador de pipelines (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect ou Step Functions)
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform/CDK)


Condições


  • Remoto, baseado no Brasil, com sobreposição de horário com os EUA (40h por semana)
  • Contrato PJ
  • Pagamento em USD, dentro dos padrões de mercado


Processo seletivo


  • Triagem — seleção das candidaturas aqui pelo LinkedIn. Apenas os candidatos selecionados receberão um contato nosso para a próxima etapa
  • Apresentação em vídeo — você envia um vídeo curto (2–3 min) apresentando um projeto que construiu (o seu melhor trabalho que possa ser demonstrado sem infringir confidencialidade), destacando as decisões técnicas e onde usou workflow agêntico
  • Entrevista final — conversa em inglês com nosso CTO e tech lead, com testes técnicos ao vivo.


Interessado(a)? Candidate-se aqui.


#vagadev #fullstack #python #postgresql #postgis #remoto #claudecode #engenhariadesoftware

title: SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect

Location

Global / Remote

Travel Requirement

Approximately 1 week per month on-site at client locations across Mexico, North America, and Europe.

Industry

Automotive Manufacturing

Platform

SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Cloud (S/4 HEC)

Language Requirement

Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Position Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect to join a globally distributed delivery team supporting complex automotive manufacturing operations. This senior-level role is responsible for the end-to-end design, implementation, configuration, and deployment of SAP ePPDS (Embedded Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling) solutions within SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Cloud environments.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working independently in fast-paced environments with limited existing documentation, taking ownership of solution design, configuration, deployment, and knowledge transfer activities. The position requires collaboration with global stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones while leading both functional and technical workstreams throughout the entire project lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end SAP ePPDS implementations and global rollout initiatives across Mexico, North America, and Europe.
  • Design, configure, and optimize ePPDS master data, including Production Process Models (PPMs), resources, production versions, work centers, routings, capacity planning models, scheduling strategies, and bucket planning.
  • Configure and manage detailed scheduling boards, planning heuristics, optimization runs, sequencing strategies, and production scheduling processes.
  • Support integration between SAP ePPDS and SAP S/4HANA modules, including PP, MM, SD, and PM, ensuring end-to-end process alignment and data integrity.
  • Configure and support repetitive manufacturing (REM) and rate-based planning processes within automotive manufacturing environments.
  • Conduct business workshops, requirement gathering sessions, fit-gap analyses, and solution design discussions with key stakeholders.
  • Operate effectively in low-documentation environments, creating comprehensive process, configuration, and solution documentation when required.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization efforts.
  • Deliver user training, knowledge transfer sessions, and operational readiness programs to ensure long-term solution sustainability.
  • Provide functional leadership and guidance throughout the full SAP project lifecycle, from discovery and design through deployment and post-go-live support.


Required Qualifications


Language Skills

  • Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish (written and spoken) is required.
  • Candidates who do not meet this bilingual requirement will not be considered.


SAP ePPDS Expertise

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on SAP ePPDS implementation and configuration experience.
  • Strong expertise in Production Process Models (PPMs), resources, scheduling horizons, planning strategies, bucket planning, and detailed scheduling boards.
  • Proven experience designing and supporting complex production planning and scheduling solutions.


SAP Landscape Experience

  • Demonstrated experience working within SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Cloud (S/4 HEC) environments.
  • Strong understanding of SAP manufacturing and supply chain integration processes.


Industry Experience

  • Solid background in automotive manufacturing operations and production planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience supporting repetitive manufacturing (REM) and rate-based planning environments.


Project Delivery

  • Proven success delivering full SAP project lifecycles, including Blueprint/Explore, Design, Build, Testing, Deployment, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.
  • Experience leading global deployments involving multiple regions and stakeholder groups.


Documentation & Process Excellence

  • Ability to work effectively in environments with limited existing documentation.
  • Experience creating business process documentation, functional specifications, training materials, and solution documentation from the ground up.


Travel

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately one week per month to client facilities located in Mexico, North America, and Europe.

This version is structured for direct use with clients, LinkedIn sourcing, ATS postings, or vendor submissions. It presents the role as a true SAP ePPDS Architect-level opportunity rather than a standard consultant position.

title: Full Stack Game Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Game Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Company Description

Hot Side Games is an iGaming studio focused on developing HTML5 casino games and proprietary gaming experiences for operators across Latin America. The company is built around Hot Side, a unique game mechanic designed to introduce an additional layer of player interaction and strategic choice into casino gameplay, creating differentiated experiences that can be adapted across multiple themes and game concepts. Leveraging the Playtagon SDK, Hot Side Games combines product innovation, game design, mathematics, and technology to deliver engaging, scalable, and commercially driven games. With a strong focus on innovation and execution, the studio brings together expertise across multiple disciplines to create distinctive gaming products that help operators stand out in an increasingly competitive market.


What you'll do

  • Build new HTML5 casino-style games using the Playtagon SDK
  • Implement game UI / animations / sound on the frontend
  • Wire up game flows to the SDK's backend hooks (session lifecycle, bet handling, results, history)
  • Integrate with RGS (Remote Gaming Server) APIs
  • Test, debug, and optimize across desktop and mobile browsers
  • Work closely with game designers (math models, visual specs) and the Playtagon team
  • Own a game end-to-end: from spec → playable build → handoff to QA / certification → deployment to operators


Must-have

  • 3+ years building HTML5 games or interactive web apps in a production environment
  • Strong TypeScript / JavaScript (modern ES, async patterns, modules)
  • Experience with at least one game/canvas engine: Pixi.js , Phaser , Three.js , or PlayCanvas
  • Solid Node.js skills for backend integration
  • Comfort with REST APIs, WebSockets, real-time event flows
  • Git workflow, code review discipline, ability to ship in a small team
  • Conversational English — written and verbal (most internal docs and partner comms are in English)


Nice-to-have

  • Prior iGaming / casino games experience (slots, instant-win, table games)
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (RNG certification, RTP, jurisdictional rules)
  • Math model implementation (paylines, probability tables, paytable construction)
  • Mobile-first / responsive game design experience
  • Experience with another game SDK
  • AI tools as part of daily workflow (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) — we lean into AI productivity


What we offer

  • Full-time, fully remote (work from anywhere in Brazil)
  • Competitive USD-denominated salary, paid monthly
  • Long-term contract, not project-based
  • Small, senior team, zero bureaucracy
  • Real ownership: you'll see your games go live with real operators, real players, real revenue
  • Continuous learning budget (courses, conferences, tooling)


How to apply

Send your CV + portfolio (links to games you built, GitHub, demos) to:


In your message, please tell us:

  • Have you worked with iGaming or game-engine SDKs before? If yes — which ones
  • Your expected USD salary range and notice period


We respond to every application within 5 business days.

title: Webflow & Framer Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow & Framer Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We're an agency obsessed with driving organic growth for our clients by creating content and websites built for humans and AI agents. We work with hyper-scale startups and scale ups in a number of verticals with a US-based clientele. We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed web developer who lives and breathes Webflow and Framer. We need someone who gets excited about clean builds, sweats the details, and keeps up with how the craft is evolving.


This is a full-time role on our development team. You'll be working across multiple client projects simultaneously, so being organized and self-directed is a must.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and maintaining marketing websites in Webflow and Framer
  • Building Full-Stack sites along with custom built tools (mini-apps) for Marketing teams
  • Translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready builds
  • Managing CMS architecture and content collections across client projects
  • Using AI tools to efficiently populate and manage large CMS datasets
  • Collaborating with clients who range from semi-technical to non-technical
  • Keeping builds clean, scalable, and well-documented


Must-Haves

  • Strong proficiency in both Webflow and Framer (not one or the other — both)
  • Solid understanding of Figma and design-to-dev handoff workflows
  • Comfortable with vibe coding. Using AI to write, edit, and troubleshoot code
  • Experience managing multiple client projects at the same time
  • Strong eye for design detail and component-level thinking
  • Ability to communicate clearly with clients and async teams


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with the MAST framework (Webflow)
  • Familiarity with Client First (Webflow naming/structure conventions)
  • Animation and micro-interaction experience (CSS, Lottie, GSAP, or native Framer)
  • Experience building full-stack marketing sites (think Vercel/Cloudflare, Astro/NextJS, and headless CMS expertise)
  • Experience using AI for CMS data management and content structuring


You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You'd describe yourself as obsessed with building websites
  • You have opinions about how components should be structured
  • You're already following where Webflow and Framer are headed
  • You learn new tools fast and don't wait to be told how

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Platform Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Own your future:

Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.


Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of professional Python development using modern practices - type hints, async/await, Pydantic, and a focus on clean, testable code.
  • LLM application engineering: building and shipping LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex, etc.).
  • Prompt engineering: structured outputs, few-shot prompting, system prompts, tool/function calling.
  • Document & unstructured data processing: PDFs, DOCX, HTML, images (parsing, chunking, extraction).
  • NLP fundamentals: embeddings, tokenization, similarity, classification, entity extraction.
  • Evaluation & testing of LLM systems: golden sets, regression tests, LLM-as-judge, A/B testing, drift detection.
  • PostgreSQL + ORM (preferably SQLAlchemy).
  • Configuration-driven design: YAML/JSON-schema-based systems instead of hardcoding logic
  • Testing discipline: pytest, test-driven mindset, writing tests alongside code.
  • Production engineering basics: logging, tracing, prompt/versioning awareness, reproducibility
  • Real production LLM experience: at least one shipped system using LLM APIs.


Nice to Have:

  • NumPy / Pandas / scikit-learn (for metrics, validation, analysis).
  • LangChain / LangGraph / LangSmith or similar orchestration tools.
  • Vector databases / RAG systems.
  • Experience in regulated industries (healthcare, pharma, finance).
  • Information extraction/knowledge graphs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize LLM-powered applications and AI features across providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and open-source models.
  • Build and improve prompt engineering solutions, including system prompts, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Develop solutions for processing and understanding unstructured data, including PDFs, DOCX, HTML, images, tables, and forms.
  • Apply NLP techniques such as embeddings, semantic search, classification, and entity extraction to solve business challenges.
  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks using regression testing, golden datasets, A/B testing, and drift detection to ensure measurable quality.
  • Optimize AI systems for cost, latency, and performance through model routing, caching, batching, and fallback strategies.
  • Design configuration-driven AI pipelines and structured output validation using YAML/JSON schemas and Pydantic models.
  • Implement data quality checks, hallucination prevention, PII filtering, and AI safety guardrails.
  • Maintain production-grade engineering practices, including logging, tracing, prompt versioning, observability, and reproducible workflows.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-quality AI solutions.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) - Remoto, Full time, Brasil


A Bytenana é uma empresa americana que constrói produtos de software (SaaS) para clientes nos Estados Unidos. Trabalhamos como parceiros de engenharia — colaboração em tempo real, mentalidade de produto e autonomia.


Qual é o perfil


Esta não é uma vaga de Data Engineer puro, nem de Full Stack fraco em dados. Procuramos um(a) Full Stack Engineer com inclinação a dados/backend : alguém que entrega produto de ponta a ponta (API em Node, tela em React, deploy em AWS) e, ao mesmo tempo, é acima da média em modelar PostgreSQL/PostGIS e construir pipelines em Python que alimentam esse produto.


Nossa stack


  • Node, React, AWS, PostgreSQL, Python
  • PostGIS / dados geoespaciais em alguns projetos


Requisitos — núcleo inegociável


  • Workflow agêntico com Claude Code (obrigatório). Não basta usar IA como autocomplete. Buscamos quem delega tarefas multi-passo ao agente (planejar → implementar → rodar testes → corrigir), usa CLAUDE.md/memória de projeto, escreve boas instruções, monta comandos/subagentes, revisa criticamente o que o agente produz, sempre assinando o commit, assumindo responsabilidade.
  • Banco de dados forte (o diferencial real do pleno que anda sozinho): modelagem relacional sólida, SQL complexo sem depender de ORM, índices, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, particionamento, transações e locks.
  • Python para pipelines em produção : ETL/ELT de verdade (não notebook), agendamento, idempotência, validação de dados, tratamento de falhas e reprocessamento.
  • Backend em Node : REST/GraphQL, autenticação, estruturação de serviço respeitando o padrão existente.
  • React : consome API, gerencia estado e entrega tela funcional (não precisa ser especialista em UI).
  • AWS : S3, RDS, Lambda/ECS, IAM básico, sabendo fazer deploy e debugar em cloud com autonomia.
  • ~4 a 6 anos de experiência prática , com autonomia em ambiguidade: recebe um requisito vago, faz as perguntas certas, decide a modelagem e entrega sem acompanhamento passo a passo.
  • Inglês suficiente para conversar e trabalhar com clientes nos EUA no dia a dia.


O que você já deve ter construído


  • Pelo menos um produto/SaaS em produção que tocou de ponta a ponta (banco → API → tela), idealmente com usuários reais e dados crescendo
  • Um pipeline de dados rodando em produção, agendado, monitorado, que já quebrou e você consertou
  • Um schema de banco desenhado do zero, com justificativa para as decisões
  • Histórico de otimização (ex.: \"uma query de 40s que baixei para 200ms\")


Diferenciais (nice-to-have)


  • PostGIS / dados geoespaciais: tipos geométricos, índices GiST, funções ST_*, projeções/SRID, tiles, mapas, geocoding, cálculo de distância/área, rotas
  • Orquestrador de pipelines (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect ou Step Functions)
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform/CDK)


Condições


  • Remoto, baseado no Brasil, com sobreposição de horário com os EUA (40h por semana)
  • Contrato PJ
  • Pagamento em USD, dentro dos padrões de mercado


Processo seletivo


  • Triagem — seleção das candidaturas aqui pelo LinkedIn. Apenas os candidatos selecionados receberão um contato nosso para a próxima etapa
  • Apresentação em vídeo — você envia um vídeo curto (2–3 min) apresentando um projeto que construiu (o seu melhor trabalho que possa ser demonstrado sem infringir confidencialidade), destacando as decisões técnicas e onde usou workflow agêntico
  • Entrevista final — conversa em inglês com nosso CTO e tech lead, com testes técnicos ao vivo.


Interessado(a)? Candidate-se aqui.

title: Coordenador(a) de Barter
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(a) de Barter em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

RAINBOW DEFENSIVOS AGRÍCOLAS

Tudo sobre crescimento.


Somos uma empresa líder em proteção de cultivos que produz, distribui e comercializa Defensivos Agrícolas.

Somos a maior exportadora de agroquímicos da China e TOP10 indústria agroquímica global, presente em mais de 100 países nos 5 continentes, com 6 fábricas próprias e um time de especialistas focados em solucionar as necessidades dos clientes.


Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos profissionais comprometidos e que enxerguem na expansão uma oportunidade de construir e transformar.


Se você quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e contribuir para transformar o futuro da proteção de cultivos no país, venha fazer parte da Rainbow Defensivos Agrícolas.


Coordenador(a) de Barter


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Construir e manter relacionamento próximo com tradings e demais parceiros de Barter, garantindo alternativas competitivas de originação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de Marketing para desenvolver ofertas e campanhas de Barter alinhadas à estratégia comercial;
  • Apoiar diretamente o time comercial na execução das operações, desde a negociação até o fechamento do deal;
  • Analisar propostas, validar cálculos, condições, lastro agrícola e exposição de risco;
  • Garantir a acuracidade, integridade e arquivamento correto de todos os documentos (CPRs, contratos, termos, cessões, garantias etc.);
  • Monitorar o fluxo das operações no SAP, assegurando compliance com processos internos e SLAs;
  • Acompanhar o pós-negócio, garantindo aderência ao calendário de liquidação do Barter e Apoiar treinamentos internos e disseminação de conhecimento sobre Barter para o time comercial.


REQUISITOS:


  • Graduação em Agronomia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atuação prévia com operações de Barter, relacionamento com tradings, análise de CPRs e documentação contratual.
  • Conhecimento no mercado agrícola, culturas e produtividade, cálculos de equivalência (sacas), avaliação de risco, noções de crédito e compliance.
  • SAP e pacote Office (Excel avançado desejável).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


DESEJÁVEL:

  • MBA/Pós em Agronegócio, Finanças ou Mercado de Commodities.
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Webflow & Framer Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow & Framer Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We're an agency obsessed with driving organic growth for our clients by creating content and websites built for humans and AI agents. We work with hyper-scale startups and scale ups in a number of verticals with a US-based clientele. We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed web developer who lives and breathes Webflow and Framer. We need someone who gets excited about clean builds, sweats the details, and keeps up with how the craft is evolving.


This is a full-time role on our development team. You'll be working across multiple client projects simultaneously, so being organized and self-directed is a must.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and maintaining marketing websites in Webflow and Framer
  • Building Full-Stack sites along with custom built tools (mini-apps) for Marketing teams
  • Translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready builds
  • Managing CMS architecture and content collections across client projects
  • Using AI tools to efficiently populate and manage large CMS datasets
  • Collaborating with clients who range from semi-technical to non-technical
  • Keeping builds clean, scalable, and well-documented


Must-Haves

  • Strong proficiency in both Webflow and Framer (not one or the other — both)
  • Solid understanding of Figma and design-to-dev handoff workflows
  • Comfortable with vibe coding. Using AI to write, edit, and troubleshoot code
  • Experience managing multiple client projects at the same time
  • Strong eye for design detail and component-level thinking
  • Ability to communicate clearly with clients and async teams


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with the MAST framework (Webflow)
  • Familiarity with Client First (Webflow naming/structure conventions)
  • Animation and micro-interaction experience (CSS, Lottie, GSAP, or native Framer)
  • Experience building full-stack marketing sites (think Vercel/Cloudflare, Astro/NextJS, and headless CMS expertise)
  • Experience using AI for CMS data management and content structuring


You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You'd describe yourself as obsessed with building websites
  • You have opinions about how components should be structured
  • You're already following where Webflow and Framer are headed
  • You learn new tools fast and don't wait to be told how

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Platform Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Own your future:

Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.


Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of professional Python development using modern practices - type hints, async/await, Pydantic, and a focus on clean, testable code.
  • LLM application engineering: building and shipping LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex, etc.).
  • Prompt engineering: structured outputs, few-shot prompting, system prompts, tool/function calling.
  • Document & unstructured data processing: PDFs, DOCX, HTML, images (parsing, chunking, extraction).
  • NLP fundamentals: embeddings, tokenization, similarity, classification, entity extraction.
  • Evaluation & testing of LLM systems: golden sets, regression tests, LLM-as-judge, A/B testing, drift detection.
  • PostgreSQL + ORM (preferably SQLAlchemy).
  • Configuration-driven design: YAML/JSON-schema-based systems instead of hardcoding logic
  • Testing discipline: pytest, test-driven mindset, writing tests alongside code.
  • Production engineering basics: logging, tracing, prompt/versioning awareness, reproducibility
  • Real production LLM experience: at least one shipped system using LLM APIs.


Nice to Have:

  • NumPy / Pandas / scikit-learn (for metrics, validation, analysis).
  • LangChain / LangGraph / LangSmith or similar orchestration tools.
  • Vector databases / RAG systems.
  • Experience in regulated industries (healthcare, pharma, finance).
  • Information extraction/knowledge graphs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize LLM-powered applications and AI features across providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and open-source models.
  • Build and improve prompt engineering solutions, including system prompts, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Develop solutions for processing and understanding unstructured data, including PDFs, DOCX, HTML, images, tables, and forms.
  • Apply NLP techniques such as embeddings, semantic search, classification, and entity extraction to solve business challenges.
  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks using regression testing, golden datasets, A/B testing, and drift detection to ensure measurable quality.
  • Optimize AI systems for cost, latency, and performance through model routing, caching, batching, and fallback strategies.
  • Design configuration-driven AI pipelines and structured output validation using YAML/JSON schemas and Pydantic models.
  • Implement data quality checks, hallucination prevention, PII filtering, and AI safety guardrails.
  • Maintain production-grade engineering practices, including logging, tracing, prompt versioning, observability, and reproducible workflows.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-quality AI solutions.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Korean)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote AI Quality Analyst (Korean) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Korean Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Korean with a high degree of comp, as Korean is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect

Location

Global / Remote

Travel Requirement

Approximately 1 week per month on-site at client locations across Mexico, North America, and Europe.

Industry

Automotive Manufacturing

Platform

SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Cloud (S/4 HEC)

Language Requirement

Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Position Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect to join a globally distributed delivery team supporting complex automotive manufacturing operations. This senior-level role is responsible for the end-to-end design, implementation, configuration, and deployment of SAP ePPDS (Embedded Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling) solutions within SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Cloud environments.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working independently in fast-paced environments with limited existing documentation, taking ownership of solution design, configuration, deployment, and knowledge transfer activities. The position requires collaboration with global stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones while leading both functional and technical workstreams throughout the entire project lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end SAP ePPDS implementations and global rollout initiatives across Mexico, North America, and Europe.
  • Design, configure, and optimize ePPDS master data, including Production Process Models (PPMs), resources, production versions, work centers, routings, capacity planning models, scheduling strategies, and bucket planning.
  • Configure and manage detailed scheduling boards, planning heuristics, optimization runs, sequencing strategies, and production scheduling processes.
  • Support integration between SAP ePPDS and SAP S/4HANA modules, including PP, MM, SD, and PM, ensuring end-to-end process alignment and data integrity.
  • Configure and support repetitive manufacturing (REM) and rate-based planning processes within automotive manufacturing environments.
  • Conduct business workshops, requirement gathering sessions, fit-gap analyses, and solution design discussions with key stakeholders.
  • Operate effectively in low-documentation environments, creating comprehensive process, configuration, and solution documentation when required.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization efforts.
  • Deliver user training, knowledge transfer sessions, and operational readiness programs to ensure long-term solution sustainability.
  • Provide functional leadership and guidance throughout the full SAP project lifecycle, from discovery and design through deployment and post-go-live support.


Required Qualifications


Language Skills

  • Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish (written and spoken) is required.
  • Candidates who do not meet this bilingual requirement will not be considered.


SAP ePPDS Expertise

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on SAP ePPDS implementation and configuration experience.
  • Strong expertise in Production Process Models (PPMs), resources, scheduling horizons, planning strategies, bucket planning, and detailed scheduling boards.
  • Proven experience designing and supporting complex production planning and scheduling solutions.


SAP Landscape Experience

  • Demonstrated experience working within SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Cloud (S/4 HEC) environments.
  • Strong understanding of SAP manufacturing and supply chain integration processes.


Industry Experience

  • Solid background in automotive manufacturing operations and production planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience supporting repetitive manufacturing (REM) and rate-based planning environments.


Project Delivery

  • Proven success delivering full SAP project lifecycles, including Blueprint/Explore, Design, Build, Testing, Deployment, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.
  • Experience leading global deployments involving multiple regions and stakeholder groups.


Documentation & Process Excellence

  • Ability to work effectively in environments with limited existing documentation.
  • Experience creating business process documentation, functional specifications, training materials, and solution documentation from the ground up.


Travel

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately one week per month to client facilities located in Mexico, North America, and Europe.

This version is structured for direct use with clients, sourcing, ATS postings, or vendor submissions. It presents the role as a true SAP ePPDS Architect-level opportunity rather than a standard consultant position.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Korean)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote AI Quality Analyst (Korean) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Korean Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Korean with a high degree of comp, as Korean is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.

title: Principal Data Engineer (e-commerce/retail)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal Data Engineer (e-commerce/retail) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life.

Our high energy, fast paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for opportunity of personal growth and success.


About the Role

Vuori is looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical foundation behind our Omni Analytics pod and our Customer Data Platform.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with broad scope — you will be the technical owner across ecommerce data, retail data, marketing and media data, identity resolution, and the CDP itself.

The data products this pod ships are how Vuori understands its customers, optimizes media spend, runs personalization, and powers retail and ecom decision making.

You will work alongside the Sr. Product Manager, Omni, and across a team that includes ecom analytics, CDP, retail, and marketing data engineering.

You will set the architecture, raise the bar on engineering standards, mentor the team, and personally build the hardest parts.

You will also partner with the Data Platform team on shared infrastructure and with Data Science & AI on activation of model outputs.

We need someone with deep experience building customer data infrastructure at scale — identity resolution, customer 360, event pipelines, audience activation, and the data foundations behind personalization and lifecycle marketing.

You should be fluent in the modern data stack, comfortable with cloud infrastructure, and equally happy in a design review, a code review, or a stakeholder conversation about what to build next.

Above all, we want a builder who lifts the team. You write code others want to learn from. You give feedback that makes engineers better. You are direct about what is broken and generous about how to fix it. You take ownership of outcomes, not just outputs, and you are the person other engineers go to when they are stuck.


What You Will Do

  • Own the technical architecture and engineering quality of the Omni Analytics pod and the Customer Data Platform
  • Lead the relaunch and ongoing buildout of the Vuori CDP, including identity resolution (IDR), customer 360, audience definitions, and activation to downstream channels (Shopify, ESP, ad platforms, in-store systems)
  • Build and maintain the data foundations for e-commerce analytics, retail analytics, marketing and media analytics, and customer journey analysis
  • Set engineering standards across the pod — code quality, testing, observability, data quality, deployment, on-call — and mentor the team to meet them
  • Be the technical voice in the room on architectural decisions: warehouse modeling, pipeline design, event schema, identity graph design, real-time vs batch, build vs buy
  • Partner with the Data Platform team on shared Snowflake infrastructure, ingestion patterns, orchestration, and data quality tooling
  • Partner with Data Science & AI on activation of models — recommendations, LTV, propensity, churn — into the CDP and downstream channels
  • Personally own the hardest engineering problems in the pod, including identity resolution logic, large-scale event processing, and any net-new platform builds
  • Manage and mentor engineers and consultants (US and offshore) in the pod, with technical leadership of the whole technical team within Omni
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and others) in your own workflow and set the standard for how the rest of the pod uses them
  • Communicate effectively on tradeoffs, risks, and priorities with both engineering peers and business stakeholders


What You Bring

  • 10+ years of data or software engineering experience, with at least 5 years building customer data infrastructure at scale — CDPs, identity resolution, event pipelines, or customer 360 platforms
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in the modern data stack: Snowflake (or Databricks/BigQuery), dbt or SQLMesh, an orchestration platform (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect), and modern streaming or event tooling
  • Strong customer data domain expertise — identity resolution patterns, deterministic vs probabilistic matching, consent and privacy considerations, audience definition, and activation patterns to downstream channels
  • Experience with CDP platform (Hightouch) and a strong opinion on how to enable experimentation and iterative build on the solution
  • Hands-on experience with e-commerce data (ideally Shopify), digital marketing and media data (GA4, ad platforms, attribution), and retail / POS data
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals — testing, version control, code review, observability, on-call — applied to data systems
  • Experience working with Data Science & AI teams to operationalize model outputs into production systems
  • Track record of technical leadership: setting standards, raising the bar, mentoring engineers, and influencing across a broader engineering org without relying on org chart authority
  • DTC, apparel, or branded consumer goods experience is strongly preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex architectural decision to a VP and to a junior engineer with equal clarity.
  • Strong proficiency with AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your own workflow
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI services like Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI.

Strong communication, collaboration, and technical influence skills.

Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.

Knowledge of observability, security, and performance for AI systems in production.

Experience working in consulting environments or embedded client delivery models.

Experience enabling teams and scaling AI adoption across engineering organizations.

title: Sr Salesforce Developer (USD-Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr Salesforce Developer (USD-Remote) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Salesforce Developer


Overview

Our client is a well-established home improvement company based in Dallas, TX, specializing in the sale and installation of windows and doors. They manage the full customer cycle, from marketing and in-home estimates to product procurement, warehousing, and installation, serving approximately 1,250 residential and commercial clients per year.


Salesforce is the central engine connecting all their business processes. The company is looking for someone who takes the time to deeply understand how the business works, cleans up and optimizes their Salesforce org, connects their tools, and helps incorporate AI where it creates real efficiency.


This is not a consulting gig, they want someone fully dedicated and committed to their team for the long term.


Main Responsibilities

Priority 1 — Salesforce Development & Administration

  • Audit and clean up the current Salesforce org: remove duplicate fields, unused flows, and legacy configurations.
  • Develop custom solutions in Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC) tailored to the company's actual business processes.
  • Maintain and evolve the CRM to meet both current and future business needs.
  • Become the internal Salesforce authority — understanding the company's workflows better than anyone.
  • Define and implement a sound architectural approach for data flow across all connected systems (QuickBooks, HubSpot, PandaDoc, and others).


Priority 2 — Business Integrations

  • Manage integrations across the full tech stack: HubSpot, QuickBooks Online, PandaDoc, Bill.com, Ramp, NiceJob, Rilla, and Zapier.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues quickly when they arise.
  • Propose and implement new connections that eliminate manual work and reduce operational friction.
  • Ensure seamless, reliable data flow from first customer contact through to final invoicing.



Priority 3 — AI & Forward-Thinking IT

  • Identify concrete opportunities to incorporate AI into business processes (e.g. inbound call filtering, follow-up automation).
  • Implement practical, real-world AI solutions — not experimental ones.
  • Support general IT initiatives and internal tech support as needed.



Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including custom development with Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Proven track record of taking time to understand the business deeply before proposing or implementing solutions.
  • Strong experience integrating SaaS tools — both native integrations and workflow automation tools like Zapier.
  • True autonomy: able to diagnose, propose, and execute without micromanagement.
  • Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Architectural mindset: ability to zoom out, assess the full system, and propose the cleanest path to seamless data flow.



Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with HubSpot — marketing automation and CRM integration.
  • Knowledge of AI tools applied to business processes.
  • Background in home services, construction, or retail companies.
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and billing tools (Bill.com, Ramp).
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, or similar).

title: Property Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Property Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview

Aspire CRE is a fast-growing commercial real estate brokerage and property management firm based in Houston. We are building a modern, content-driven CRE company that combines best-in-class service with media, technology, and operational excellence.

We move fast. We operate with urgency. We value clear communication, personal accountability, and follow-through.

Please note: This position is for remote employees located outside of the United States. Required working hours are US Central Time 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Property Accountant to manage full-cycle accounting for our growing portfolio of commercial properties. You will serve as the primary accounting partner for property managers, asset managers, tenants, lenders, and third-party vendors — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely financial reporting across all entities.

Our property-level accounting is managed in Yardi Breeze/Voyager. Proficiency in Yardi is required.

Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Coding

▸  Ensure all transactions are accurately coded in Yardi — proper GL classification of income, expenses, and balance sheet items

▸  Maintain organized records and chart of accounts across multiple entities and properties

Accounts Payable

▸  Manage the full A/P process in Yardi — enter vendor invoices, route for approval, and process payments once approved

▸  Monitor Yardi invoice workflows to ensure no bills are missed; troubleshoot any workflow issues as needed

Accounts Receivable & Tenant Billing

▸  Record and deposit tenant rent payments in Yardi; administer billing for rent, CAM, NNN recoveries, and other lease-related charges

▸  Monitor A/R aging and follow up on delinquencies in coordination with property management

▸  Review lease documents and maintain accurate lease data within accounting systems

▸  Provide tenant ledger reports or account statements upon request

Bank Reconciliations

▸  Reconcile property bank accounts (operating and security deposit accounts) on a monthly basis

▸  Reconcile balance sheet accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting

▸  Perform full month-end close for each property by the 10th of the next month — accruals, journal entries, and account reconciliations

▸  Prepare monthly financial reports for property owners: income/expense statements, balance sheet, rent roll, and supporting schedules

▸  Ensure reports are delivered on time with complete accuracy, exported from Yardi

Operating Expense Reconciliations

▸  Assist with annual operating expense reconciliations and CAM/NNN tenant recoveries

▸  Support budget preparation, forecasting, and variance analysis

Vendor Management & 1099s

▸  Maintain vendor records in Yardi (W-9 info, payment details, addresses)

Cross-functional Coordination

▸  Collaborate with property managers, asset managers, and our internal team on all accounting matters

▸  Coordinate between Yardi on any crossover items

▸  Communicate clearly and promptly via email with the team during US Central business hours

Qualifications

▸  Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

▸  3+ years of accounting experience with meaningful exposure to commercial real estate property accounting

▸  Demonstrated experience with full-cycle property accounting: AP, accruals, bank reconciliations, and financial statement preparation

▸  Working knowledge of commercial lease structures, CAM/NNN recoveries, and tenant billing

Technical Skills — Required

▸  Yardi Breeze or Yardi Voyager — must be proficient across the full accounting cycle (AP/AR, reconciliations, reporting, workflows)

▸  Microsoft Excel — advanced proficiency required for reporting, reconciliation, and analysis

Soft Skills & Work Style

▸  Highly detail-oriented — you double-check entries, reconciliations, and reports before submission

▸  Self-starter who can manage multiple property deadlines independently and without reminders

▸  Excellent written and verbal communication — clear, professional, and prompt

▸  Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving team with minimal supervision

▸  Proactive mindset — you identify and resolve accounting issues before they escalate


How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit a resume to . Your email should also include:

▸  A brief introduction about yourself and your background in commercial real estate accounting

▸  The scope of Yardi work you have handled — how many properties, what types (office, retail, industrial, mixed-use), and your specific role

▸  Specific tasks completed in Yardi: AP entry and payments, AR and rent processing, bank reconciliations, financial reporting, CAM reconciliations, 1099 preparation, etc.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: Aspire Commercial is proud to be committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of age, race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking to hire a Senior Payments Engineer to help build a next-generation payment orchestration platform.



Our company operates in the payments space today, and this role will be instrumental in designing and building the infrastructure that sits between merchants, gateways, processors, and acquiring banks.


The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on experience with modern payment platforms such as Adyen and/or Stripe and understands payment flows at a systems level.

Key Areas of Experience

  • Direct experience building integrations with Adyen and/or Stripe APIs
  • Experience with payment orchestration, intelligent routing, gateway abstraction, and multi-processor environments
  • Deep understanding of card processing, authorization flows, settlement processes, tokenization, vaulting, recurring billing, and end-to-end payment lifecycle management
  • Strong backend engineering background, including API architecture, distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization
  • Experience with PCI compliance, fraud prevention, risk controls, payment security, and regulatory requirements
  • Proven track record building payment infrastructure and core payment systems—not simply consuming third-party payment APIs

Preferred / Bonus Experience

  • Merchant acquiring, sponsor bank relationships, ISO/MSP environments, or PayFac (Payment Facilitator) models
  • High-volume transaction processing systems
  • Alternative payment methods, ACH, digital wallets, and international payment processing
  • Building payment gateways, gateway routing engines, processor-agnostic payment platforms, or payment orchestration layers

Role Expectations

This individual will play a key role in architecting the platform, making critical technical decisions, and owning significant portions of the payments infrastructure. We are looking for someone who can operate strategically at the systems-design level while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in implementation.

title: founding engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para founding engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Pango is building an agentic operating system for e-commerce logistics, unifying shipping, tracking, returns, and warehouse workflows into one platform powered by AI agents .


We're based in Stockholm and San Francisco and backed by some of the most Some of the most prominent investors in the world. Less then a year we have seen massive growth where we can't keep up with the demand and need engineers to bring the product faster to the market.


What you'll be responsible for


  • Building and maintaining production-grade services across our Laravel monolith and Google Cloud Functions layer
  • Shipping merchant-facing React surfaces that turn complex logistics workflows into something a brand operator actually wants to use
  • Owning carrier, warehouse, and shop-system integrations end to end, from the first webhook to long-term reliability
  • Driving performance, cost, and reliability improvements through experiments, profiling, and pragmatic refactoring
  • Enabling the broader team with primitives, tooling, and shared infrastructure that make the next feature faster to build


Your hard skillset


  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience overall
  • Strong experience in one backend language (PHP, Ruby, Python, Go, or Rust) with genuine willingness to go deep on PHP/Laravel OR strong experience in React
  • Comfortable across the stack: backend services, frontend, message queues, caches, search, infrastructure as code
  • Experience at product-focused startups using modern tooling and processes
  • Bonus: Shopify, multi-carrier shipping APIs, or e-commerce logistics experience
  • Bigger bonus: you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it
  • Even bigger bonus: you've integrated LLMs or agentic workflows into production, not just a demo


Your soft skillset


  • Comfortable being uncomfortable, making calls with incomplete data, and changing your mind when the data changes
  • Empathetic and curious. You build for the merchant, not for the benchmark
  • Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and go-to-market. No lone wolves
  • Detail-oriented but pragmatic. You know when accuracy matters and when to ship
  • You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


Growth and levels


We operate on a transparent leveling framework. Each level reflects increasing ownership, impact, and scope, with real jumps in salary and equity. Promotions are based on output, not tenure.


This isn't a comfy engineering role. It's fast, focused, and merchant-obsessed. You will launch fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship.


The process


Intro call with the founders (30 minutes)

Technical walkthrough and async take-home task (approximately 60 minutes)

Final round with the team (half day, on-site if possible)

By the end, you'll be wanting access to the stack before your first day, because you'll see exactly what kind of company we're building, and exactly how fast your career can move inside it.

Sobre nós

O varejo físico responde por mais de 80% das vendas no Brasil — e nenhuma das conversas entre vendedor e cliente virava dado. A KOL resolve isso: capturamos interações no PDV via áudio e entregamos inteligência real para gestores de varejo. Produto validado, pipeline ativo, estágio inicial. Buscamos um Senior Machine Learning Engineer para compor o nosso Founding Team e assumir a camada de speech e inteligência conversacional — os sistemas que transformam conversas reais em lojas físicas em transcrições, insights estruturados e sinais acionáveis para gestores. Você vai trabalhar onde a qualidade da IA determina o valor que o cliente percebe.



O que você fará

–     Assumir ownership pelo pipeline de speech-to-text e análise conversacional.

–     Avaliar e melhorar qualidade de transcrição em ambientes ruidosos de lojas físicas.

–     Trabalhar em diarização, identificação de papéis dos interlocutores e processamento de transcrições.

–     Desenhar fluxos com LLMs para extração estruturada de insights, resumos, objeções e comportamentos de venda.

–     Construir datasets de avaliação, métricas de qualidade, feedback loops e versionamento de modelos e prompts.

–     Fazer benchmarks de provedores de speech-to-text, diarização e LLMs.

–     Trabalhar com produto e engenharia para tornar insights de IA confiáveis e acionáveis.



O que buscamos

–     Forte experiência em IA aplicada, engenharia de ML, NLP, speech ou engenharia de dados.

–     Forte experiência com Python.

–     Experiência construindo pipelines em produção, não apenas notebooks ou experimentos.

–     Experiência com LLMs, extração estruturada, versionamento de prompts e modelos, e avaliação.

–     Capacidade de trabalhar com dados reais, ambíguos e ruidosos.

–     Forte senso de produto em torno de qualidade, confiabilidade e confiança do usuário em sistemas de IA.



Diferenciais

–     Experiência com speech-to-text, diarização, processamento de áudio ou dados conversacionais ruidosos.

–     Background em conversation intelligence, sales coaching ou analytics para call center.

–     Experiência com fluxos de anotação, revisão humana ou otimização de custo e latência em IA.



Você pode ser a pessoa certa se...

Você já colocou um pipeline de IA em produção, viu ele falhar de formas inesperadas com dados reais e construiu os mecanismos de avaliação para entender exatamente onde e por quê. Você não considera um modelo bom porque performou bem no benchmark: só quando funciona com os dados bagunçados do mundo real. Você se importa com a confiança do usuário final no output da IA — e sabe que essa confiança é construída com métricas, feedback loop e muito trabalho de avaliação, não com hype.
