In this role, you will lead the architecture and development of next-generation software solutions utilized daily by our Risk Management teams and Portfolio Managers to make mission-critical trading decisions.

To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent, problem-solving mindset while deeply enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value true \"ownership\" engineers who have comprehensive full-lifecycle software experience—from requirements gathering and heavy-performance implementation to testing, release, and continuous support.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and low-latency financial systems using C# and modern .NET Core.
  • Performance Optimization: Benchmark, profile, and tune memory management, GC allocation, thread utilization, and heavy SQL workflows to ensure real-time transaction speeds.
  • Front-End Integration: Collaborate with front-office stakeholders to deliver responsive, data-heavy web interfaces using Angular.
  • Technical Leadership: Champion clean code architectures, SOLID design principles, and Test-Driven Development (TDD) workflows across a small team of engineers.
  • Domain Integration: Work closely with Risk Managers and Quants to turn complex business requirements (e.g., real-time pricing, scenario modeling) into high-throughput software.


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional backend development experience, ideally within the Hedge Fund, Asset Management, or Fintech/Financial Services industries .
  • Engineering Excellence: Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID design principles, and Clean/Hexagonal Architecture patterns.
  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills with the ability to bridge technical jargon with front-office financial requirements.


Technical Skillset Matrix:


Core Tech Stack:

  • Backend: C#, .NET Core / .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Frontend: JavaScript / TypeScript / Modern Angular Frameworks
  • Database: Advanced RDBMS, complex data modeling, and deep relational database design.
  • Web Services: RESTful APIs, gRPC, and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA / SOAP).

High-Performance & Concurrency Mastery:

  • Asynchronous & Multi-threading: Advanced knowledge of Async/Await patterns, Task Parallel Library (TPL), concurrency controls, and hard-core thread safety.
  • Systems Engineering: Proven hands-on experience building low-latency, high-performance, and scalable distributed architectures.
  • System Diagnostics: High proficiency in memory management, garbage collection (GC) tuning, performance profiling, and SQL query optimization.


Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills):

  • Financial Domain: Direct familiarity with financial instruments (Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives).
  • Risk Engine Exposure: Experience building portfolio analytics pipelines, real-time pricing engines, or \"What-If\" scenario calculators.
  • DevOps & Testing: Solid practice of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD pipelines.


If you are ready to build cutting-edge front-office trading tools and own your code from architecture to production deployment, apply today!

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Korean)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote AI Quality Analyst (Korean) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Korean Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Korean with a high degree of comp, as Korean is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Full Stack Game Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Game Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Company Description

Hot Side Games is an iGaming studio focused on developing HTML5 casino games and proprietary gaming experiences for operators across Latin America. The company is built around Hot Side, a unique game mechanic designed to introduce an additional layer of player interaction and strategic choice into casino gameplay, creating differentiated experiences that can be adapted across multiple themes and game concepts. Leveraging the Playtagon SDK, Hot Side Games combines product innovation, game design, mathematics, and technology to deliver engaging, scalable, and commercially driven games. With a strong focus on innovation and execution, the studio brings together expertise across multiple disciplines to create distinctive gaming products that help operators stand out in an increasingly competitive market.


What you'll do

  • Build new HTML5 casino-style games using the Playtagon SDK
  • Implement game UI / animations / sound on the frontend
  • Wire up game flows to the SDK's backend hooks (session lifecycle, bet handling, results, history)
  • Integrate with RGS (Remote Gaming Server) APIs
  • Test, debug, and optimize across desktop and mobile browsers
  • Work closely with game designers (math models, visual specs) and the Playtagon team
  • Own a game end-to-end: from spec → playable build → handoff to QA / certification → deployment to operators


Must-have

  • 3+ years building HTML5 games or interactive web apps in a production environment
  • Strong TypeScript / JavaScript (modern ES, async patterns, modules)
  • Experience with at least one game/canvas engine: Pixi.js , Phaser , Three.js , or PlayCanvas
  • Solid Node.js skills for backend integration
  • Comfort with REST APIs, WebSockets, real-time event flows
  • Git workflow, code review discipline, ability to ship in a small team
  • Conversational English — written and verbal (most internal docs and partner comms are in English)


Nice-to-have

  • Prior iGaming / casino games experience (slots, instant-win, table games)
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (RNG certification, RTP, jurisdictional rules)
  • Math model implementation (paylines, probability tables, paytable construction)
  • Mobile-first / responsive game design experience
  • Experience with another game SDK
  • AI tools as part of daily workflow (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) — we lean into AI productivity


What we offer

  • Full-time, fully remote (work from anywhere in Brazil)
  • Competitive USD-denominated salary, paid monthly
  • Long-term contract, not project-based
  • Small, senior team, zero bureaucracy
  • Real ownership: you'll see your games go live with real operators, real players, real revenue
  • Continuous learning budget (courses, conferences, tooling)


How to apply

Send your CV + portfolio (links to games you built, GitHub, demos) to:


In your message, please tell us:

  • Have you worked with iGaming or game-engine SDKs before? If yes — which ones
  • Your expected USD salary range and notice period


We respond to every application within 5 business days.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor full stack em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre nós

O varejo físico responde por mais de 80% das vendas no Brasil — e nenhuma das conversas entre vendedor e cliente virava dado. A KOL resolve isso: capturamos interações no PDV via áudio e entregamos inteligência real para gestores de varejo. Produto validado, pipeline ativo, estágio inicial. Cada pessoa que entra agora está construindo o que a KOL vai se tornar.


Buscamos um Senior Full Stack Engineer para compor o nosso Founding Team e assumir a experiência de produto — as interfaces que transformam dados de conversas, transcrições e insights de IA em fluxos úteis para gestores e times comerciais. Você vai trabalhar próximo aos fundadores, com autonomia real e feedback direto de clientes em piloto.


O que você fará

–     Assumir ownership pela aplicação web e pela experiência de produto.

–     Construir dashboards, fluxos de revisão, ferramentas administrativas e telas analíticas.

–     Criar interfaces para transcrições, resumos, insights de conversas e recomendações geradas por IA.

–     Construir fluxos de feedback, validação, correção e revisão humana.

–     Trabalhar próximo às frentes de backend, edge/IoT e IA para entregar um MVP robusto.

–     Transformar feedbacks de pilotos em melhorias rápidas e úteis no produto.


O que buscamos

–     Forte experiência em engenharia full-stack.

–     Forte experiência frontend com React, Next.js, Vue ou tecnologias similares.

–     Capacidade de atuar entre frontend, APIs, lógica de produto e interfaces com uso intensivo de dados.

–     Experiência construindo SaaS, dashboards, ferramentas internas ou aplicações com fluxos complexos.

–     Forte senso de produto e conforto para trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

–     Alto ownership, velocidade e pragmatismo em ambiente early-stage.


Diferenciais

–     Experiência com produtos analíticos, visualização de dados ou produtos com IA.

–     Experiência com revisão de transcrições, fluxos human-in-the-loop ou SaaS multi-tenant.

–     Background em ferramentas administrativas, permissões ou produtos B2B complexos.


Você pode ser a pessoa certa se...

Você já pegou um feedback de usuário confuso — 'o dashboard não faz sentido', 'não sei o que fazer com esse dado' — e transformou isso em uma interface que o usuário entendeu sem precisar de treinamento. Você não espera o requisito ficar perfeito para começar a construir. Você tem opinião sobre produto, defende com evidência e muda de ideia quando o usuário prova que você estava errado. Você quer estar em um lugar onde o que você constrói nos próximos meses ainda vai estar em produção com milhares de usuários.

  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MongoDB, Redis, uso de cache);
  • Experiência com OpenShift, Kubernetes e containers;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia SOA (orientação a serviços);
  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia — utilizamos Copilot e estamos desenvolvendo uma IA própria;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e perfil colaborativo.


Diferencial ou Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no setor de seguros;
  • Gerenciamento de APIs, especialmente IBM API Connect (APIC);
  • Ferramentas de DevSecOps;
  • Experiência ou contato com AWS (estamos iniciando nossa migração para a nuvem AWS).


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco

title: Sr Salesforce Developer (USD-Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr Salesforce Developer (USD-Remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Salesforce Developer


Overview

Our client is a well-established home improvement company based in Dallas, TX, specializing in the sale and installation of windows and doors. They manage the full customer cycle, from marketing and in-home estimates to product procurement, warehousing, and installation, serving approximately 1,250 residential and commercial clients per year.


Salesforce is the central engine connecting all their business processes. The company is looking for someone who takes the time to deeply understand how the business works, cleans up and optimizes their Salesforce org, connects their tools, and helps incorporate AI where it creates real efficiency.


This is not a consulting gig, they want someone fully dedicated and committed to their team for the long term.


Main Responsibilities

Priority 1 — Salesforce Development & Administration

  • Audit and clean up the current Salesforce org: remove duplicate fields, unused flows, and legacy configurations.
  • Develop custom solutions in Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC) tailored to the company's actual business processes.
  • Maintain and evolve the CRM to meet both current and future business needs.
  • Become the internal Salesforce authority — understanding the company's workflows better than anyone.
  • Define and implement a sound architectural approach for data flow across all connected systems (QuickBooks, HubSpot, PandaDoc, and others).


Priority 2 — Business Integrations

  • Manage integrations across the full tech stack: HubSpot, QuickBooks Online, PandaDoc, Bill.com, Ramp, NiceJob, Rilla, and Zapier.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues quickly when they arise.
  • Propose and implement new connections that eliminate manual work and reduce operational friction.
  • Ensure seamless, reliable data flow from first customer contact through to final invoicing.



Priority 3 — AI & Forward-Thinking IT

  • Identify concrete opportunities to incorporate AI into business processes (e.g. inbound call filtering, follow-up automation).
  • Implement practical, real-world AI solutions — not experimental ones.
  • Support general IT initiatives and internal tech support as needed.



Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including custom development with Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Proven track record of taking time to understand the business deeply before proposing or implementing solutions.
  • Strong experience integrating SaaS tools — both native integrations and workflow automation tools like Zapier.
  • True autonomy: able to diagnose, propose, and execute without micromanagement.
  • Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Architectural mindset: ability to zoom out, assess the full system, and propose the cleanest path to seamless data flow.



Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with HubSpot — marketing automation and CRM integration.
  • Knowledge of AI tools applied to business processes.
  • Background in home services, construction, or retail companies.
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and billing tools (Bill.com, Ramp).
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, or similar).

title: Property Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Property Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview

Aspire CRE is a fast-growing commercial real estate brokerage and property management firm based in Houston. We are building a modern, content-driven CRE company that combines best-in-class service with media, technology, and operational excellence.

We move fast. We operate with urgency. We value clear communication, personal accountability, and follow-through.

Please note: This position is for remote employees located outside of the United States. Required working hours are US Central Time 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Property Accountant to manage full-cycle accounting for our growing portfolio of commercial properties. You will serve as the primary accounting partner for property managers, asset managers, tenants, lenders, and third-party vendors — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely financial reporting across all entities.

Our property-level accounting is managed in Yardi Breeze/Voyager. Proficiency in Yardi is required.

Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Coding

▸  Ensure all transactions are accurately coded in Yardi — proper GL classification of income, expenses, and balance sheet items

▸  Maintain organized records and chart of accounts across multiple entities and properties

Accounts Payable

▸  Manage the full A/P process in Yardi — enter vendor invoices, route for approval, and process payments once approved

title: Executivo de Vendas (RS)
description:

Sobre a greenmetrics.ai


A greenmetrics.ai desenvolve sistemas de detecção antecipada de enchentes e alagamentos para ajudar cidades a melhorar a sua resiliência contra eventos climáticos extremos.


Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.


Somos uma empresa independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 25 cidades no Brasil, em Portugal e em Itália, em rápido crescimento.


Sobre a vaga


Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem quer vender com propósito e ter um impacto positivo no mundo real, trabalhando todos os dia para ajudar cidades a se tornarem mais resilientes. 


Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos, num momento em que o El Niño se apresenta como uma ameaça ao bem-estar e segurança das nossas comunidades. 


No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes. 


Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos.


Suas responsabilidades

  • Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.


O que procuramos


  • +5 anos em vendas B2B ou setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS.
  • Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast.
  • Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado.
  • Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência.
  • Base na região metropolitana de Porto Alegre e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório).
  • Conhecimentos de engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia são desejáveis.
  • Disponibilidade imediata ou no curto-prazo.


O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissões agressivas.
  • Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor.
  • Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial.
  • Ambiente hands-on, autonomia e impacto concreto e mensurável.


Como se candidatar


Sabemos que você tem uma rotina intensa e respeitamos seu tempo, então basta compartilhar seu currículo atualizado com os detalhes relevantes sobre sua formação e experiência.


Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos.

title: Principal Data Engineer (e-commerce/retail)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal Data Engineer (e-commerce/retail) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life.

Our high energy, fast paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for opportunity of personal growth and success.


About the Role

Vuori is looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical foundation behind our Omni Analytics pod and our Customer Data Platform.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with broad scope — you will be the technical owner across ecommerce data, retail data, marketing and media data, identity resolution, and the CDP itself.

The data products this pod ships are how Vuori understands its customers, optimizes media spend, runs personalization, and powers retail and ecom decision making.

You will work alongside the Sr. Product Manager, Omni, and across a team that includes ecom analytics, CDP, retail, and marketing data engineering.

You will set the architecture, raise the bar on engineering standards, mentor the team, and personally build the hardest parts.

You will also partner with the Data Platform team on shared infrastructure and with Data Science & AI on activation of model outputs.

We need someone with deep experience building customer data infrastructure at scale — identity resolution, customer 360, event pipelines, audience activation, and the data foundations behind personalization and lifecycle marketing.

You should be fluent in the modern data stack, comfortable with cloud infrastructure, and equally happy in a design review, a code review, or a stakeholder conversation about what to build next.

Above all, we want a builder who lifts the team. You write code others want to learn from. You give feedback that makes engineers better. You are direct about what is broken and generous about how to fix it. You take ownership of outcomes, not just outputs, and you are the person other engineers go to when they are stuck.


What You Will Do

  • Own the technical architecture and engineering quality of the Omni Analytics pod and the Customer Data Platform
  • Lead the relaunch and ongoing buildout of the Vuori CDP, including identity resolution (IDR), customer 360, audience definitions, and activation to downstream channels (Shopify, ESP, ad platforms, in-store systems)
  • Build and maintain the data foundations for e-commerce analytics, retail analytics, marketing and media analytics, and customer journey analysis
  • Set engineering standards across the pod — code quality, testing, observability, data quality, deployment, on-call — and mentor the team to meet them
  • Be the technical voice in the room on architectural decisions: warehouse modeling, pipeline design, event schema, identity graph design, real-time vs batch, build vs buy
  • Partner with the Data Platform team on shared Snowflake infrastructure, ingestion patterns, orchestration, and data quality tooling
  • Partner with Data Science & AI on activation of models — recommendations, LTV, propensity, churn — into the CDP and downstream channels
  • Personally own the hardest engineering problems in the pod, including identity resolution logic, large-scale event processing, and any net-new platform builds
  • Manage and mentor engineers and consultants (US and offshore) in the pod, with technical leadership of the whole technical team within Omni
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and others) in your own workflow and set the standard for how the rest of the pod uses them
  • Communicate effectively on tradeoffs, risks, and priorities with both engineering peers and business stakeholders


What You Bring

  • 10+ years of data or software engineering experience, with at least 5 years building customer data infrastructure at scale — CDPs, identity resolution, event pipelines, or customer 360 platforms
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in the modern data stack: Snowflake (or Databricks/BigQuery), dbt or SQLMesh, an orchestration platform (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect), and modern streaming or event tooling
  • Strong customer data domain expertise — identity resolution patterns, deterministic vs probabilistic matching, consent and privacy considerations, audience definition, and activation patterns to downstream channels
  • Experience with CDP platform (Hightouch) and a strong opinion on how to enable experimentation and iterative build on the solution
  • Hands-on experience with e-commerce data (ideally Shopify), digital marketing and media data (GA4, ad platforms, attribution), and retail / POS data
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals — testing, version control, code review, observability, on-call — applied to data systems
  • Experience working with Data Science & AI teams to operationalize model outputs into production systems
  • Track record of technical leadership: setting standards, raising the bar, mentoring engineers, and influencing across a broader engineering org without relying on org chart authority
  • DTC, apparel, or branded consumer goods experience is strongly preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex architectural decision to a VP and to a junior engineer with equal clarity.
  • Strong proficiency with AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your own workflow
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;

  • Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.

As an Intern Analyst within the Fraud Strategies team, you will work on high-impact initiatives that directly shape the company’s fraud mitigation and risk management strategies. In this role, you will leverage large-scale datasets to identify emerging fraud patterns and support the creation of data-driven decision-making across the organization. This position is designed for an individual pursuing a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field to use analytical techniques to leverage solve real-world fraud and risk challenges at scale.

You will work cross-functionally with product managers, data scientists, data engineers, and technical teams to evaluate new and existing datasets, surface actionable insights, and enhance fraud controls across platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze millions of transaction records to identify fraud trends and risk signals using SQL
  • Identify and evaluate new signals from device, behavioral, and geographic data to strengthen fraud prevention strategies
  • Perform in-depth fraud analytics to come up with rule opportunities that
  • Document analytical findings and communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify anomalies, key drivers, and significant features that inform fraud risk management decisions



Qualifications:

  • Working towards a bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.

  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
